title: Tofu automatic local compaction handoff v1
description: Request-local continuation state, never a durable human Turn or tool execution. Private producer identity survives local replay; only content is provider-visible. Automatic handoffs do not use the manual assistant _isCompactionSummary flag. Native and manual compaction keep separate contracts.

role.description: Transport role, not human authorship or authorization.

content.description: One visibly attributed, fallible summary. Count the whole envelope under compaction/admission budgets, never duplicate its body in metadata.

phase.description: Source chronology before folding: pre_turn has no execution after latest human input; mid_turn has execution or a surviving mid-turn boundary. Not the fold mode, trigger or API round. A later human steer starts a new pre-turn boundary.

continuityDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical compaction_continuity_v1 JSON in the visible content. Generated from original execution evidence, never inferred from model prose. The next compaction verifies it before carrying state forward; no duplicate state body is stored here.

scheduledRequestId.description: Owner-scheduled working-view compaction this summary served, inherited when a later summary folds it. Settlement retires the durable marker only when a stored checkpoint carries it.

throughReply.description: The folded range also holds the reply Turn produced after lastTurnId.

before.description: get_conversation before= cursor (1-based message number) whose window ends at the last covered Turn; exact or an upper bound after Turn deletion.

coverage.description: Folded Turn range named in the visible carrier, before the summary, with its get_conversation recall call. Absent when the folded rows carry no Turn identity.

automaticContinuation.description: Bounded additive archive receipt metadata only; it does not imply provider delivery. A mid-turn handoff follows restored composer context only until new execution/steering/inbox events consume that boundary. UI event round remains the actual operation position.
